My only complaint, if I had to make one (and I will), is that the khua khling is somehow not as spicy as I expected, despite being labeled the spiciest item on the menu; I wanted the sweat off your face feeling (a la everything at Ugly Baby) but this was more of an aggressive tongue and throat tickle. The crab curry weirdly felt more spicy. Nevertheless, both are great choices. 

You really can't lose here unless you have fish or seafood allergies; in that case why are you even on this yelp page lmao.

We have always loved this place. The food is impeccable.  Got there at around 6:38 PM on a Saturday and the wait was 1.5 hours, but, despite the wait and the snafus you'll read about below, TOTALLY WORTH IT. The food made me forget how angry I was.

What we had:
Raw shrimp in some sort of vinegar/sweet/fish sauce/spicy sauce mix that was perfection
Crab curry--very large chunks of crab
Crab Aob Woonsen--my very very very favorite. This is the dish I would want for my dying meal. 

The reason I am taking a star away:
1. I was not allowed indoors to use the restroom because they'd reached capacity inside, so I waited outside. However as I waited, two people (one after the other) subsequently strolled in and no one stopped them. Which pissed me off so much because why the arbitrary enforcement of rules? The hostess--she who shooed me away--was standing right there when the two other folks walked in. (Okay I understand, if it's busy this may not have been her priority. But I was pissed anyway.)
2. They gave our table away. After we had waited 1.5 hours (at the 1 hour mark they told us they'd be able to seat us in about 20 minutes, but that didn't happen because they made the mistake of seating someone else at the table earmarked for us). They sat us right away when they realized it, but you know, at other establishments, they'd try to make it up to you somehow, like comping something.  

A final fantastic note though: They called us back because the hubs left his man purse. That was very nice of them--they didn't have to.

*Disclaimer I'm not a seafood fan, with the exception of a few options, so I played it safe with my choices and would def go with something like the branzino if I was more into fish.* 

I've been dying to try this place for a while now. I wish I had the chance to try more, but I went with the zaab wings and scallop red curry (which was a special)! They were both great, but def want to go again and try the clams! The thai iced coffee was very sweet and not my cup of tea (or should I say cup of coffee), but everything else was really good. Our waitress was lovely and weekday lunch was the perfect time to go because there was no wait!

So glad I finally had the chance to try Fish Cheeks! I tried getting a table for four a month ago (Friday night) and the wait was still an hour. I was able to get seated in 10 minutes for a table of 3 on a Tuesday evening. Our waiter was attentive and was spot-on with his crab fried rice recommendation. 

Food/Drinks: There were chunks of crab in the fried rice & it is such a simple dish, but delicious. The crab curry was definitely thai SPICY and it went so well with rice on the side. The Khua Kling was packed with fresh seafood and the flavor was subtle. The oysters were fresh and the green sauce on the side gave them an unique touch. Cocktails were ok, but you get your bang for yo buck! As a gin drinker, I really enjoyed their Butterfly Effect drink.

FYI: there is only one bathroom, so there can be a long wait.

Probably one of the best dining experiences in all of nyc. The Coconut crab curry is incredible and man the tiger prawns are as huge as lobster tails. The sauce is incredible. Fingers crossed there won't be any more shut downs so the world can appreciate the amazing food places like Fish Cheeks has to offer!

Update: came here for outdoor dining! 
All the tables were spaced out nicely or had dividers. They were placed in the middle of bond street, which looked so nice!
There's hand sanitizer in the front and they take your temperature as well before you are seated. All COVID regulations were being followed. 
We started with oysters, which are 1.50$ from 12-6. They put a nice spicy sauce on top which adds to the flavor. We also got the shrimp appetizer and it was my first time eating raw shrimp and I loved it! The same sauce as the oysters was on the shrimp and it was delicious and had a good spice level. 
Unfortunately after appetizers the service got really slow. 
For entrees, we got the crab aob woosen, crab fried rice and the scallop red curry special. I really liked the crab fried rice and scallop red curry. Unfortunately I felt the crab aob woosen could've used a bit of spice or some sauce. 
For dessert, we got the lemongrass custard over coconut sticky rice. It was good, but not really for my palette. 
Overall, I'm really happy with my experience here. I'm glad this restaurant strives to be unique and focus on seafood in their Thai cuisine.

This place never gets old and the flavors are always so amazing, favorite Thai / southeast Asian place in the city

Must try - oysters, pork cheeks, crab curry, crab fried rice, grilled branzino, tiger prawn

I came to this restaurant since my SO had been wanting to try it for a while and after running some errands around chinatown/soho area, decided to come to this place for lunch. 

As far as safety goes, Fish Cheeks does a really good job of keeping everyone as COVID free as possible. Right when you inquire about available seating, the hostess asks for your name and number, and then measures your temperature before seating you. The tables are pretty spread out from each other to ensure safety. 

The waitress was pretty informative in describing and recommending dishes as well as telling us the specials. 

They have happy hour from 12 pm to 6 pm, which entails discounted beer, wine, $11 cocktails, and $1.5 oysters. The cocktails were all pretty interesting, all with some twist of Thai flavor. I ordered the spicy mango (it had mezcal in it) and it was delicious! 

We ordered the small fish "salad," the coconut crab curry, the ground beef dish (forgot the name), and the morning glory side. The small fish salad was DELICIOUS. I'm so glad that our waitress recommended to us. It was the perfect blend of lemongrass, basil, and spice! The dressing went really well with the deep fried fish and fish skin. Highly recommend. 

The coconut crab curry was really rich and flavorful--slightly sweet and the perfect amount of spiciness. It went really well with the morning glory and paired pretty well with the ground beef that we ordered. The ground beef dish was pretty much all meat and had no veggies. There was some sort of large, herby bean in it that was also cooked. It was pretty tasty as well if you like lots of meat. The morning glory veggie dish was so worth and so delicious! If you like veggies, this is definitely something worth getting. It seemed to have very little ingredients (just sauteed with garlic and spicy peppers), but had such a nice umami flavor.

For dessert, we ordered the coconut custard with coconut sticky rice, wrapped in a banana leaf. The dessert portion wasn't too large but if you're expecting it to be similar to mango sticky rice, it's not. The custard was pretty interesting as the consistency looked similar to uni. I think I would prefer the sticky rice paired with mango or some other fruit instead, but I'm glad to be able to try the dessert. 

This place is kinda pricey, but everything is delicious! The service is also very professional and pleasant. I hope to come back to be able to try their whole fish dishes. Definitely come if you're a fan of Thai food!

I ordered their steamed fish for delivery and it was so delicious! The lemongrass/chili broth was served in a separate container that you can use to dress over the fish; I ended up just drinking it straight out of the container because I didn't know any better. The fish was still really delicious though, and steamed to perfect. It was not as salty as I'd liked, but again, I did slurp down all of the broth beforehand.
Steamed fish and the tiger prawns WOW WOW WOW. Extremely authentic thai. Nostalgic time of meal. Bold flavor. 10 out of 10. A new favorite for sure.

Truth bomb: I got influenced by IG to come here & it was WORTH IT. 

Yes, it's picture worthy. The service is on point. The cocktails are delicious. The oyster HH is also delicious;  I recall the oysters being small. 
 
BUT THAT WHOLE FISH THOUGH! Served on the best whole fish platter, perfect for pictures, but even better tasting than it looks. 

I sincerely hope they survive 2020.

This spot is soooooo yummy, no joke. But warning the dishes we got were all spicy especially the coconut curry. 

First, the ambience of this spot is super cute. There is a built seating area outside with a roof and then they have more tables around the built seating place. There is hand sanitizer in the front and everyone was wearing a mask. 

Now my friend took me here to show me truly how authentic this place is and boy was she right!! So this is Thai place and the most authentic spot in the city, hands down. 

Second, the yummy, delicious, mouth watering food!! We first got the oysters, which are fantastic. This dish comes with this green spicy sauce and crunches to put on top. This whole combo is fantastic. I would suggest not soaking the oyster in the sauce because then the sauce over powers the oyster taste. But that's up to you haha. 

Next, we got the Po Tak. Loved it!! It's basically a soup with all type of seafood and I would say it's a medium type of spicy nothing to crazy. Also, don't forget to add the Jasmine rice into your soup!! Sooooo good. 

Finally, we come to the Coconut Crab Curry. This is absolutely delicious BUT soooooo sooooo soooo spicy. Now I think I have a pretty good tolerance for spicy food and my friend has an even higher tolerance but boy did we get our buts kicked haha. Long story short this dish is extremely spicy. I would recommend getting a Thai iced tea, which will help with the spiciness. Funny enough when we ordered our SECOND Thai iced tea we shared with our wonderful waiter that we are about to die because of how spicy this dish is. The waiter says oh it's not so bad, not that spicy. LOLLOL OK WAITER. We had a good laugh all together. 

Side note: The Sweet Cheeks sweaters that all the employees were wearing were soooooo CUTE OMG. I really wanted one and still would LOVE one haha. 

Overall this spot is amazing. Food is just out of this world and service was great too. LOVE LOVE this place now and I can not wait to come back!!
This place came highly recommended and it didn't disappoint one bit. The oysters were super fresh and the Shrimp Karee was sooo good.  I must come back again!
Me and my bf's go to place for date nights. Highly recommend this place. Great authentic Thai food and very tasty drinks. Must try.

Glad this spot is open during quarantine. Food is of great quality as it was pre-COVID. Unfortunately I had my food packed up and half of it was left out. If I ask for my food to be packed up I expect the full amount I paid for. If I pay for a whole fish I expect the whole fish to be packed. I'm very disappointed in being  out of food I paid for considering the price.

My mouth is literally watering right now as I write this review about Fish Cheeks. This is my all time favorite Thai place EVER and trust me...I take my Thai food VERY seriously. It's my favorite cuisine and I spent some time in Thailand last year as well yet the food at Fish Cheeks is really just out of this world. 

I usually come here on fancy dates and on my birthday with my family and each time I savor every moment of it. Their seafood is FRESH and the spices in all the dishes are blended together masterfully. When I'm eating idk if I should try to stop myself so I can take some home and enjoy it later on. 

I highly recommend the coconut crab curry and the steamed fish! I get these two almost every time and each time you have to almost roll me out of there cause I'm so stuffed. And if you're there for happy hour, they have amazing oysters with a unique sauce to go with them. 

The staff here are always super nice and quick! It's usually a super busy restaurant so I recommend going at a non popular time or making reservations (right now no reservations can be made cause of covid). 
I went with a friend on a Friday night last week and was told the wait would be about 30mins but it ended up being 1hr. By the time I sat down, I was ready to eat the dining table lol.

If you're looking for a special Thai food experience- unlike your usual pad Thai and green curry or if you're just looking for some life changing PHENOMENAL food this is THE spot.

Perhaps the best meal of COVID 2020.  Given the fact that we must all normalize curbside dining i have to save this place is wining!! It helps that its located on a not too busy side street with ample distance between diners and street walkers. From start to finish a meal filled with flavors and ample portions of divine food. S t r o n g drink which is a plus plus plus. To die for wings!! Maybe didnt need a side of rice for the curry crab but ate it anyway. Glad we made it for lunch as dinner lines are surely packed!!!

This place is amazing! Tried to get in here for a while, and finally made it during Covid. Seafood is great here. Had the crab curry and the prawns with the egg. Fav was the prawns, highly recommend it.

I came here for the first time last night for dinner and I was really impressed! First of all, the staff is super friendly. Secondly, the food is excellent! The vegan green curry is amazing! Everything was super fresh and had a depth of flavor. It seriously may be the best green curry I've had in NYC! The cabbage side dish was also delicious!

Additionally, I really liked their cocktails. All around, a great experience - I'll definitely be back!

Excellent and delicious food. Highly recommended if you want an elevated Thai cuisine flavor. 

Definitely try the raw oyster with their in house sauce. Absolutely delicious and addictive. 

The pomelo salad is another must although this might depend on the season. Not always on the menu. 

I have tried almost all the dishes on the menu and they were all delicious. 

My favorite Thai restaurant to go to in the city.

Absolutely amazing & FLAVOR-FULL!!! 
Enjoyed the atmosphere - the outdoor dining was intimate & meets COVID-19 guidelines.
The fish surpassed all expectations after receiving its recommendations from the staff. The fish's texture was tender & melt-in-your-mouth good. There's heat in this dish (not just the temp), but the herbs & spices balanced the heat off well with a slightly sweet, citrus & clean finish. Paired off with a side of rice makes it a satisfactory meal unlike any other in this menu. The oysters were tender & fresh. The herbs used to dress them were my fav. The crunchy topping to the right (delicious), but felt like too much texture for me (personally) to pair with these scrumptious mollusks. Great spot in the evening. Looking forward to visiting while the sun is out! Overall, the staff was indeed very friendly, attentive & following COVID-19 guidelines. Truly a gem in NoHo.
Everything here is divine. Their wings, pork cheeks, coconut crab curry, fish entrees are all to die for. Dining is family style so grab a friend and go to town.

The best southeast asian food in the city. So much so that I broke my no takeout during covid rule.  I ordered dinner to go through the app and it was super quick. All of the servers had masks and we're very respectful.

One of the best restaurants in NYC. Make sure you get a reservation otherwise you will be looking to wait for 45 minutes. ( during pre-pandemic). Crab curry -wow, zabb wings- husbands favorite, steamed fish with Thai herbs m-WOW, corn salad-good. And fried fish is also good but I prefer the steamed fish. I hope this restaurant makes it through this pandemic.

This is by far one of the best meals I've had in a long time. I randomly came across this restaurant walking around noho and the outside colors drew me in immediately. 

What I love about this place is that it is authentic thai food and it lives up to the hype. No you won't see pad thai or drunken noodles on the menu. You'll find real, thai seafood dishes. 

I asked for recommendations and ended up getting this spicy appetizer salad that was super yummy. Their thai breaker cocktail had a beautiful balance of tropical flavors - i wanted to order two! Then for mains we had the fried fish with garden salad and crab curry. You HAVE to try the crab curry and at least one of their fish dishes. They are packed with so much flavor! 

I was truly blown away by the food here. The plates are on the smaller side, but still share-able. For the quality and taste, it is worth the price. I'm already planning on coming back in a week.

I was brought to Fish Cheeks with the promise that "you're going to love it". And sure enough, the meal that I had at Fish Cheeks was unforgettable. As soon as you walk in, the hustle and bustle of New York and colorful tables immediately catch your eye. The place is always packed and the tables are really cramped, but reservations are really easy to make online. We ordered half a dozen oysters as appetizers that were good enough to disguise my friend's hate towards fresh oysters. Next, we ordered the famous coconut crab curry and tiger prawn karee with a side of sauteed cabbage. The coconut crab curry is by far one of the most popular dishes that Fish Cheeks is known for, but I personally thought that tiger prawn karee was so much more flavorful which makes the other dishes very promising. Though the dishes are on the pricier side, the amount of flavor packed into these dishes make every dollar worth it. I will definitely be coming back to try the other dishes the next time I'm in town.

**this visit was pre-COVID, but looks like everything is the same except with outdoor dining

TL;DR - If you have to eat at one Thai spot in the city this should be it.

This spot is fantastic and being on Bond street they have the perfect set up for outdoor dining. That street hardly has cars or crowds of people walking by and the cobblestone street is a nice touch. Even before quarantine this place had a knack for the bright decor, which combined both an inviting and elevated/sophisticated feel to the space.

Now to the food. I've been here a few times always making sure to get the coconut crab curry and mix it up with an appetizer and another entree. And each time I take that first bite I forget all my troubles because this food does things. Here's what I've ordered so far from the menu:

Oysters - If you're an oyster person you can do no wrong ordering these with your group. Big fan of how they swap out the traditional tartar for like a fish sauce / vinegar (I think it's that) mixture.

Corn Salad - Let me just say I don't even like tomatoes raw and I'd eat them in this dish. Well balanced, light, and a great way to start. I'd say these and the oysters make a good appetizer combo if you're eating with a group of 4 or more.

Grilled Pork Cheeks - Nice texture/chew and is nice and salty (not salty in a bad way). If you're big on having meat for an appetizer go for this, but as mentioned above the corn salad and oysters take top spots for me.

Fried Fish vs Steamed - As a Filipino, fried fish is in my heart (quite literally) so I have a soft spot for a well cooked fried fish, BUT the first time I came here they were out so my roommate and I got the steamed fish. And let me tell you...steamed fish here is unreal. In this instance the steamed fish does it because not only is it juicy and tender, also it really soaks up the cilantro lime broth it's in and pairs really well with rice. The fried fish is good too but if you have to pick one pick the steamed.

Khua Kling - Think of this as a Thai sloppy joe (minus the buns) but in a good way lol. Caution to the wind this dish is spicy af and I enjoy spicy food, but it has that lingering burn if you eat enough of it. If you were to pick another entree aside from the crab curry try the fish before this one unless you really want a spicy dish.

Coconut Crab Curry - No meal at Fish Cheeks is right in the world without the crab curry. Velvety curry and plentiful crab meat. Enough said.

I haven't written reviews during quarantine, but this restaurant was amazing enough to take me out of my hiatus. The outdoor dining section is lovely- with tables under a canopy and each table divided by a plastic section in between. 

The pork cheeks were an amazing appetizer- highly recommend! Each piece is super tender and juicy, and the sauce it comes with added a really nice fish sauce-y, nutty flavor. 

The crab fried rice and branzino were my favorite out of the main courses. They do not skimp out on the crab meat on the fried rice, and the green sauce that comes with it was amazing. They really took a simple dish and elevated it. The branzino was melt-in-your-mouth soft and the sauce that came with it was amazing too. 

The crab curry was delicious, but my least favorite out of the dishes I ate today. It was super flavorful and had so much crab meat, but it did have a very strong, slightly overpowering ginger flavor. 

Overall, all the dishes were pretty solid and I really enjoyed my experience there. Would definitely go back again!

We reserved a table online for 5 ppl at 7pm. My friends arrived, the host confirmed her and seated her while we on our way, then they kicked her out of the table after they seated her, they gave the table to someone else's. My ladies friend's got really embarrass (who would seated guests in a restaurant and unseated them?) then I came, the host was giving me attitudes, said they do only take walk in. Which is a lie. "I DID RESERVED A TABLE ON YOUR WEBSITE" We was ok with it and patiently wait for our table, Coconut Crab CurryCoconut Crab CurryCrab Fried RiceCrispy Garlic Branzinothen the rain came all our foods were wet, so we decided to packed our half way finish foods togo and canceled the deserts. While we were paying inside and waiting for our Uber to arrive, the waitress try to kick us out again (btw, we all wore masks as we run from the rain and we also want to give space to the table next to us because of covid. That why we paid to leave) 

What a bad Dinning experience. 

The whole outdoor dining experience for us at this restaurant was unpleasant. Bad customer services handling and some disrespectful staff members to customer. The foods is just so so, lots of better Thai restaurants in the city anyway, so I will not come back here again. I Am writing this review so this restaurant can learn to serve their customers better. Because the foods is not so cheap here. Good luck.

This is one of my FAVORITE restaurants in NYC right now

Must-tries: Every dish I've had has been crave-worthy. All the dishes are a slightly different spin on traditional Thai food. My must-tries are: pork cheeks (I always ask for seconds of the flavorful sauce it comes with), oysters (comes with fried shallots, and a slightly spicy-herby green sauce), and grilled fish with thai herbs

COVID-era: They have a beautiful patio with dividers. 

Pro tips: come for happy hour for $1.50 oysters and discounted drinks

Big flavorful portions. My roomie and I were so full halfway down the meal but we couldn't stop eating cause everything was so delicious. Highly recommend the steam fish for anyone who likes a tangy kick. The coconut crab curry also has fair amout of spice that works so well to offset the creaminess of the dish.

After seeing a friend post about her excellent experience at Fish Cheeks we decided to visit for our anniversary dinner. Fish Cheeks is delicious! The delectable fried fish, oysters, and crab fried rice were worth the 20+ minute wait. We sat outside in a safe socially distanced atmosphere with partitions between guests. Thank you to the server who helped me navigate my food allergies safely and easily. Their gluten free options are truly yummy. Highly recommended for anyone who (like us) is interested in venturing out for a safe outdoor meal and needs a break from cooking at home. We can't wait to return.

Literally the best Thai food in the city.  Like, ridiculously delicious. Crab fried rice is my all time fave. 
And whatever sauce they have on the side, omg  
Where was I? Oh right, well seriously, if you're looking for quality Thai, this is THE spot

I have been wanting to try Fish Cheeks for quite some time now and finally got around to it! Although my visit was during COVID, I do not think I missed out on the experience or the flavor at all. Fish Cheeks offers outdoor dining and social distancing. They have some tables on the side walk as well as a wooden structure offering two person tables separated by walls. The structure is painted with lively colors and has plants decorating the backsides which gives you a pleasant ambiance. 

I tried the happy hour oysters, which tasted nice and salty. The green chimichurri type sauce they served with the oysters was especially tasty on top! After I had the grilled branzino and crab fried rice. The rice was simple yet delicious. It was filled with lump crab meat and enough for 2-3 people. The grilled branzino was served with a delicious cashew sauce and was so tender/fall off the skin soft! I will certainly be back!

Fish cheeks is still operating and the oysters are now $1.50 for happy hour and $11 for cocktails except for the something special drink. They do outdoor dining with dividers. This time I tried the steamed fish with Thai herbs and wowwww the fish was so good! Barely any bones besides a few small ones and the sauce with the limes go so well with rice which you have to order separately. But the fish was soft and so flavorful. They also keep it heated with a small fire beneath it. So frigging good!!

Pretty amazing place for some authentic food. Booming with flavor. My favorite is the crab curry it has some spice to it which I love but be careful if your not found of heat. They have happy hour $1.50 oysters and this thai green sauce they give you with it is next level. Definitely worth the check out. They also have outdoor seating so it's nice even during these times. I've been coming here for 3 years and I've never been disappointed

This is an amazing establishment that I hope can weather the storm that is COVID-19. My wife and I went here a couple times and we can't believe we didn't try this place sooner. The food here is so delicious. Plus the colorful scalloped awning of the restaurant entrance is quite cute.

CRAB FRIED RICE~ Perhaps the best fried rice dish I've ever had; what looks like normal fried rice is really chock full of flavor, plus the pieces of crab are nice big. Definitely something to get when you go here.

ZABB WINGS~ loved their seasoning so much that we bought a jar of it. Hot and crispy, salty and sweet, lemongrass-y. If you like wings, you'll like this.

STEAMED FISH~ the piece de resistance of the meal, yo. Whole steamed fish in a cilantro-lime broth, topped with lots of mint and other herbs that give a lot of bright vibrancy to a fish that is already delicious, swimming in that broth and all. Yum.

Gots to go back and try more dishes, I hear that crab curry is killer.

This is my 1st time ordering from here. I ordered a grilled fish and a steamed fish. The fishes are very fresh. The taste is good. Unfortunately the sauce from the grilled fish was spilled out and mess up the bag.

Sawadee kah, Fish Cheeks!! Fish Cheeks offer outdoor seating right now so patrons could taste their DELECTABLE Thai food during this pandemic. 

Everything was extremely flavorful (food-wise) and the drinks were strong and delicious. We got the following:

- pork belly - YUMMY, so tender, so juicy, sauce is to die for
- mussels in a curry - yum, but not for me (not a big mussel/clam/oyster girl)
- crab fried rice - a bit on the bland side but still FIRE. they give you fish sauce and a green hot sauce to elevate the flavors and the dish certainly rose to new heights. Good amount of crab meat too!
- jumbo prawn - Twas DELISH. only comes with three so beware if you're sharing with your dinner mates. 

All in all, this was a satisfying meal. My only complaint is that portions were TINY for the prices we were charged. My friends and I usually split dishes with each other and left pretty hungry. 

I recommend this place but don't come completely starving unless you're willing to throw down some bills!

Staff is friendly and accommodating. Food is consistent, have yet to try something that wasn't delicious. Maybe a little pricey but I find myself going back again and again. Zab wings, fried fish, steamed fish, crab fried rice... hell everything is amazing. Only complaint is the amount of crab in the coconut crab curry. All in all highly recommended.

I wish I lived closer so I can eat this whenever I want to which is quite often!!! 
I was lucky enough to eat here before Covid shutdown and the food is so freaking amazing I couldn't stop raving about them or thinking about the food. They only allow reservation online for up to 4 people. Groups bigger than that will have to wait and be seated which can be a pretty long wait. (Note: this was pre-shutdown and the line can be quite long because the place is pretty small) 
The food was amazing. I had the pork cheeks, the oysters, the crab fried rice, the shrimp curry and wok fried morning glory (veggie) on the side. 
The oysters were so fresh and sweet, not briny. My sister who is not really a fan of raw oyster loved it. 
The pork cheeks was tender and good and of course can't go wrong with morning glory. It's my fav summer vegetable to eat.
The crab fried rice was so freaking good I could eat the whole serving by myself! 
The shrimp curry, while on the spicy side for me, was so amazingly fragrant and well spiced we asked for more rice to eat the sauce!

Overall, this is a fantastic spot and they are offering take out due to COVID-19 so you have an opportunity to taste their food without waiting in line! Go now!

Fish Cheeks is open for takeout! Someone suggested it to me and I took a look at the menu. To be completely honest, my first reaction was: no noodles on the menu? Only because Thai broad rice noodles are what I craved for a few months while in quarantine. But that disappointment changed quickly once I tasted the food. Every. Single. Thing is delicious and perfectly spiced. The corn salad was perfect, with fresh corn and Thai bird's eye chili. The pork cheeks are so tender and the sauce is amazing. I couldn't get enough of the green curry, and somehow their mango sticky rice has the perfect savory-sweet combination. If you're like me and trying to plan out quarantine meals: Fish Cheeks food tastes just as good the next day, so if you order some and savor it over a few days, it just gets better as it marinates in the various sauces.

Went after they recently opened again for outdoor dining. The outdoor set up for social distancing was well done. Our favourite things were the steamed fish and chicken wings! We also had the crab curry which was fantastic. They were really accommodating of a couple of requests and overall service was great!

***Pre-COVID*** A close friend and I came for an early dinner with HH still in effect. We were able to walk in and grab a table in the back area, which was perfectly fine for us! The ambiance is really cute, with fish-related decor (I mean, with a name like Fish Cheeks what else are you expecting) that wasn't too tacky. We ordered the HH oysters (soooooo good! Would definitely recommend, they're only $1); HH cocktails (Butterfly effect was so good, we had to order 2!); the coconut crab curry (just alright. Crab meat was really fine and tender, but not sure it was worth the $24 price tag); and the Zabb wings (my friend and I are definitely medium spicy kinda girls, but this was definitely in the spicy to extra spicy range, our tastebuds cried for a couple hours after the meal). Would come back for strictly happy hour and maybe not much more, but everything was enjoyable.

The Thai food here seems more authentic.  Like they do not have pad thai, drunk noodles, or any of the usual American Thai-friendly dishes.  

I really enjoy the crab curry.  It is extremely spicy (like as spicy a dish as you can find in this city) and the flavor profile is crab more than anything else.  It really hits the spot for me when I want something flavorful, spicy and different.  The crab fried rice is as expected quite bland on its own though with lovely chunks of crab, but it comes with these Thai sauces to season it which make it salty more than anything else.  I would also highly recommend the pork cheeks which are a satisfying blend of meaty and fatty with a light sauce.
I just ordered two items; the chicken wings and the crab fried rice. Might be the most delicious things I've tasted!

We went here during Restaurant Week 2020. I had heard of it from our Lord and Savior Chrissy Teigen, so I had high expectations.

WAS NOT DISAPPOINTED. We ordered the Coconut Crab Curry (SPICY), Zabb wings, and crab aob woonsen. My favorite by far was the woonsen...wooooooow. Sweet, savory, lip-smacking good. The curry was spicy, but not so much that I couldn't enjoy it. I understand the hype. The Zabb wings were awesome too -- kind of a lime-y spicy salty seasoning blend that I am pretty sure they sell now. 

These people have been working so hard during COVID to feed essential workers and it warms my heart. Not only is the food delicious, but they also have great big giant hearts! I cannot wait to go back and continue to support them. I wish I lived close enough to order now!!

LOVE Fish Cheeks. This also strangely seems to be the only spot in this country where one can snag some properly cooked morning glory? 
The Coconut Crab Curry, Tiger Prawn Karee, Grilled Branzino, and Pakboong Fai Dang are deeeelicious
Over rated! Just some crab meat in curry sauce and white rice. Nothing extraordinary.

Quarantine review: I had been wanting to try Fish Cheeks for a while. Finally had a reservation lined up, then the shut down happened and I never got to go. Fortunately, however, they have been open for take-out, so I have finally gotten to have the Crab Fried Rice I was dying to try and it did not disappoint. Have ordered from here a few times since the shutdown and it's been consistently good. Have also tried the Coconut Crab Curry, it's a little spicy but also very good. If you had been waiting to get a reservation like me, take advantage and try their take-out.

Food tips: Crab Fried Rice

Can't believe it's taken me so long to write a review for one of my favorite restaurants in the city. 

I've been coming here for years now and the food is consistently the best thai food in all of Manhattan. Highlights on the menu are really everything... you just can't go wrong here. 

But the fried fish with herbs, the crab fried rice, and the Zabb wings are always standouts. 

I could eat Fish Cheeks weekly for the rest of my life. And until I can sit-in and enjoy it in person, I'll be doing this via takeout :) 

Also - now they sell the Zabb wing seasoning which is OUT OF CONTROL!! you can put it on pretty much anything. Highly recommend you adding this to your order when you checkout. There's nothing like it.

I have been coming here for years and I want to say this is my favourite place for Thai. I cannot get enough of their food. Whenever my friends are in town, I always tell them to come here or we would all come here to dine.

I hope this place survives the pandemic because I ate here 2x a week and I am always craving their food.

In our current situation, I haven't had their food for a long time, but since I had to go to necessary doctor's appointment, I was able to come here for food pickup. I can honestly say, I haven't been this excited for food in such a long time. This place makes me so happy!

This restaurant makes the best crab fried rice and their green sauce aka nam jim seafood sauce is to die for.

They offer that delicious green goodness on their oysters and I love the hell out of it.

The numerous times I have been here, these items below are my stable.
Crab Fried Rice - the best thing on earth and the size of the crab lumps are perfect
Zabb Wings - these wings have a nice kick to them and they currently are selling the rub.
Oysters - the sauce is super addictive and they now sell them too
Crab Curry - so yummy and also has a good heat to them
Manila Clams - love this dish as well, it reminds of this dish that my mother would make with pipi.
Pork Jowl - I usually get this for people who are more meat eaters than seafood, but it is still a solid dish. 
Mango Sticky Rice - I love this seasonal dessert, they make it so good here. Some places the rice is bland or hard.

Please survive the pandemic - you'll be the first restaurant I dine in with friends after we get a vaccine.

The accolades are warranted. This emperor has new clothes. And they're amazeballs.

You like happy hour? You like cheap drinks that are creative and discounted? Come here. Fish Cheeks has one of the best hidden, under-the-radar HHs I've found in Manhattan. Every cocktail is single digits (I think $8?) and full of fun SE Asian ingredients that'll make your tastebuds sing.

But the food. Oh glory be, the food. There isn't a single item on the menu that isn't made to perfection and packed with so much umami, your mouth will be culinary mecca. The Pork Cheeks were so crisp, so tender, so perfectly marinated, I still dream about them during lockdown and wake up crying because I live too far to order delivery. 

The Pomelo salad--full of pomelo, dry-aged fish, cilantro, mint, Thai bird's eye chili, lime, and fried shallot--was the best salad any of us had had in years. We couldn't stop gorging on it like a pack of vultures. Even the simple sauteed cabbage was crisp, garlicky and packed with flavor. It got the seal of approval from one friend who HATES cabbage. How is that possible?

I can't wait to throw of the corona shackles and come back here. Fish Cheeks, pleeease don't go away before I can make it back to the LES!

This place is one of my favorite Thai restaurants in the city. If you don't like spicy food, then I suggest not dining here as all of the food is spicy, which I love. This is my 2nd Fish Cheeks experience: I ordered delivery via Caviar to support them due to the current shelter in place regulations. I ordered the coconut crab curry which is out of this world amazing. The serving of crab in the to go container was very generous. This dish is very spicy, so be careful eating it. I ordered a side of morning glory which was also good. During my first visit, we ordered the pork cheeks followed by the coconut crab curry, steamed fish and shrimp pineapple fried rice. If I lived closer, I would go to this place at least 1x per month.

Omg the tiger prawn is so good. Hole in the wall
Place but really good food !! Pricey but good

O M G!!! This place is a total GEM!!! I wish it wasn't so far downtown that way I can visit it frequently. I had the best experience w my Godmother during restaurant week. The food was magical and the presentation just as colorful and bright as the restaurant itself. All meals have shareable quantities although after the first bite you won't want to share.

I ordered tiger prawn karee and pak boong through caviar and holy shit it tasted just like what you would get in Bangkok. However, the packaging was poorly designed and thought of because the sauce seeped through the paper boxes. They shouldn't have used paper boxes for dishes that have a lot of sauce. As a result, my order came with the paper bag all damaged and sauce spilt all over the it. If it wasn't for the packaging, I would have given a complete five stars

Such a cute vibe, but most of all, the food is so so authentic. I love their happy hour oysters (the sauce they use is something else), and their steamed fish is to die for. I keep going back since their service and the food is a top notch.
The food was excellent but they overcharged me by 50 dollars, luckily I caught the mistake.

This place is great! My boyfriend and I dined here for Valentine's day and it's an awesome mix of upscale and laid back. The atmosphere is ideal for almost any occasion! I can't say enough about the food, we got the Dorade dish that comes whole and I can't recommend it enough. 

Our server Cory made the evening! He was knowledgable, friendly and patient with our indecision! He made our experience and helped us navigate the intricate and unique menu with ease. We formulated the perfect dinner thanks to his guidance.

Amazing Thai cuisine. Cozy space, efficient service.

We loved most dishes, while avoiding the too spicy ones !

Manila Clams. Tom Yum. Crab Aob woonsen. Tiger Prawn karee. Yum Hed Yaang.

Plenty of food for our group. Definitely worth the visit!

Love it here! We ordered Set 1 for 2 people and it was definitely a lot of food but we loved getting to try everything. Every dish was very fresh and flavorful (and spicy!!). The crab curry and the fish were both incredible. The exotic flavors were much more similar to the food in Thailand than your typical thai takeout restaurant. Drinks were great too and they have a great happy hour. Highly recommend!!

Came here for restaurant week, so was a little limited in what I was able to order. Most of the things I tried were delicious & I would love to return to try some of the other things on the menu. 

Food: 
-Zabb wings: these were great! juicy, flavorful, lemony & spicy dry rub wings
-somtum corn salad: this could've been a little better. I've definitely had more authentic, flavorful, and spicy versions of this salad
-crab aob woonsen: this was a really interesting dish! it came in a little pot, with thinnnnn glass noodles and crab on top. the sauce was pretty mellow, kind of a soy saucy base. what saved this dish was the sauce that came on the side--this had a stronger taste! I poured it all over the noodles, so yummy

I thought that restaurant week gave me a nice taste of what fish cheeks has to offer, but there is so much more on the menu that i want to try. will definitely return in the future for the crab fried rice and some of the curries!

Before I get to the bad, here is the FAB!

I came here with 3 of my girlfriends for a birthday dinner. We ordered SET 1 ($105), the Crab Aob Woonsen (sooo yummmmmy) and oysters for happy hour. Honestly we would've been perfect with just the set and oysters. Too much foooood!!! 

APPETIZER: 
- ZAAB WINGS: Hands down my fav dish from the menu. The crisp to meat ratio is literal bomb.com! Not to mention the seasoning. This is a MUST HAVE!! Please order and thank me later. 
 
- CORN SALAD: A bit too sweet for my taste, but it was a nice refreshing touch to balance out the wings. 

MAIN COURSE
- FRIED FISH: I wish it had more meat - the pictures kinda look deceiving. Although this dish was good, it was a bit too salty for me.

- COCONUT CRAB CURRY: My 2nd favorite dish! I know that many people aren't fans of curry, but this curry is very mild. The coconut blend really brings out the flavors and the crab meat is flipping tender. I'm literally drooling as I type this rn. loll 

- TOM YUM HAENG: A bowl mixed with shrimps, clams, mussels. Seafood lovers - def get! 

Alrighhtttttttt. I am giving 4 stars because... 

There was a lack of organization from the hostess to waitress. I called in ahead of time and confirmed to do a surprise candle lit dessert for my friend. I also checked in early and confirmed with the hostess in order to make this happen.  

Unfortunately, once we finished our meal, the waitress seemed to have forgotten..  We still wanted dessert so we ordered and she gave us the check and totally forgot to give us our order so we just left... ummm what. 

Buttttttt aside from that, def recommend!

Definitely go with a reservation, but it would honestly be worth the wait. It was absolutely delicious. We did the set for three people, which was probably smart as it was our first time there. The grilled pork cheeks were delicious and so tender. The chicken wings looked like they might be bland but were so lemony and seasoned perfectly. However, my favorite was the shrimp salad/soup thing we started with. It was something I had never tasted before and was amazing. We also topped it off with some oysters, which had a garlicky, but the fresh sauce that you expected to be very spicy, but was a perfect balance. 

For dinner, the crab curry is a can't miss. It is flavor-packed and creamy and was my favorite of the entrees for sure. There was a clam soup/curry thing that was a bit too fishy for my taste. The whole fried fish was delicious. I wish it came with more of the greens, but it was much lighter than I was expecting it to be. Lastly was this medley of seafood (fish, clams, mussels, calamari) and mushrooms. The mushrooms absorbed all the sauce and were absolutely delicious. Would highly highly recommend to anyone who wants to try anything new.

Absolutely solid five star and more. This is a really shinning gem. If you want to enjoy the world top class Thai foods, here is the place we recommend. Three of us (artist/painter, musician, me) recently dined here. OMG what a great foods they served! 

I usually do not write down too much details of each dish because it could spoil your discoveries and dining adventures. Nevertheless for this awesome restaurant, I want to share two dishes you must dine to tell others. One is the Tiger Prawn Karee. From the moment the dish is served, you will immediately know this is a masterpiece with it's plating but you will be shocked how amazing it taste from the first bite. OMG fabulous!

Another dish you must have here is the coconut crab curry. I hope you do not have the shellfish allergies. Because this is another memorable truly delicious and fabulous dish here. OMG so good! 

If you have not been familiar with the spicy foods such as the Indian foods and Thai foods, I recommend the Thai foods first. And this restaurant should be one of your list of Thai restaurants to visit this year. Trust me. Three of us all highly recommend.

Came here for the first time tonight. Firstly I have to give a shoutout to the amazing host who held a table for us. She was absolutely phenomenal! Now about the food... They had me at the wings! Talk about flavor on 100!! Then came our drinks. A mango chili tequila mixture. I'm bad with remembering the name but it was A-Mazing! Then came our main meal. There was nothing left once we got started on all our dishes. I tell you, this place rocks!! And Corey, our waiter, that man is all sorts of awesome. It was like he cooked everything on the menu, he explained every detail of every dish so well!! We are coming back for more
Super unreliable wait time. Told us that the table will be ready in 20-35 minutes. After 50 we still had to wait. Very unpleasant experience and rude staff at the entrance.

I love this place! I came here with two friends on a Thursday night with a 5:30 reservation - I showed up almost 30 min late (I know I'm one of those people, but not really because the subway was significantly delayed!). My friends had to wait for me to sit but we still got the table until 7:30 and the food came quickly so no big deal. We got the happy hour deal with oysters, which had the most amazing sauce. We then did the 3 person set dinner, which is a great deal and honestly loved not having to decide - $150 for 7 dishes. I wish more restaurants did this deal. Particularly, I loved the Pork Cheeks, Maitake mushroom salad, Coconut Crab Curry, and dipping the fried dish into the Prawn Lon. Nothing disappointed, one of my favorite thai restaurants and definitely unique from the standard ones with the emphasis on seafood. As a plus, our waiter was extremely friendly and attentive, which only made the experience better!

Authentic seafood focused Thai dishes took me back to my recent Thailand trip. We had the prefixe for three. Right amount of food. Caution, most dishes are spicy. Crab curry, fried fish, and Prawn Lon were favorite

UM PLEASE TRY THIS PLACE. It's a must, I am so glad I stumbled upon this place. 

We tried the crab fried rice, which honestly may look bland initially but there was so much flavor packed into each bite. It also came with sauces that really kicked things up a notch.

Crab aob woonsen was on the smaller portion for its price but it was still very flavorful with notes of cilantro.

Tiger prawn karee is not pictured because I immediately dug into it LOL but 3 huuuge prawns and such a unique flavor profile for the sauce served under the prawns. I just wish it came with jasmine rice to balance out the sauciness. 

I didn't get to take advantage of their HH but um, can I just mention that its every fricking single day AND extended hours of 12-3:45 pm in addition to the regular 5-7 pm? If that isnt love, idk what is :')

Hi Jennifer, 
Thanks for writing. I'm sorry you didn't find my first review constructive. I do think customers would be interested to know that several of your condiments  and dishes contain MSG; such as your crab fried rice. From what I understand, the sauce in this rice is made with jarred condiments containing MSG. I got this information from your staff. If this is not entirely correct, then I was given misinformation. The problem overall was that my friend and I felt pretty sick after eating there and when we discovered the root cause was MSG we were surprised and disappointed. I would suggest adding MSG to your menu's dish descriptions because I think many people are sensitive to this ingredient. I hope you find this second review more constructive. 
Thanks,
Jackie

Loved the food here. My favorite by far was the grilled pork cheeks app. I could have eaten this dish myself but shared with 3 others (enough slices for everyone to have more than 1). Doesn't look like much but every slice was super flavorful and juicy. It comes with Jeaw sauce but honestly didn't need it because it was already that good as is. The Tiger Prawn Karee was another table favorite- multiple people marveled at the sauce and the prawns themselves are great too (just be prepared to get a little messy taking the shells off). The crab curry was also pretty good and actually spicier than the Khua Kling which is supposedly their hottest dish. Don't think this place is Thai spicy because yours truly could handle both those dishes...Both beef and crab curry both came with a bowl of rice. If I were to pick between the two, crab curry wins hands down, but it's way more saucey so if you want change of pace vs the Karee the beef is a fun option- also different types of spicey (builds vs immediate). The crab fried rice is food but nothing special - it was a nice filler though against all the other more flavorful dishes and I felt we kind of needed it despite the dish itself not being super memorable/special. You could probably achieve the same thing by just ordering extra bowls of plain rice. We didn't try any of the alcoholic drinks but I did have a Thai ice tea which was tasty! But that's just because Thai ice tea is great - wouldn't say theirs was anything unique. 

Only small suggestion is to seat parties even if not full if they have a reservation (eg not a walk in so you have a spot reserved for them in that time slot) and your restaurant is over half empty at that hour anyways...

This was an AH-MAZING meal from beginning to end.  We ordered about 80% of the menu and every dish was more delicious than the last.  Balanced, hitting all the right notes and full of umami.  The service was impeccable and restaurant had a great vibe. One of the best Thai restaurants I've been to.  I highly recommend and can't wait to go back.

Fish Cheeks has easily become one of my go to restaurants. They always have some dope jams playing with a chill dimmed lighting while I'm sipping my Basil Tito's with a soda. They have a concise menu that is filled with seafood. To start off, the Zabb Wings were phenomenal. Zingy, tangy, spicy, and perfectly fried.  My favorite dish is the Tiger Prawn cooked with a delicious garlic egg sauce. Always get a bowl of rice to dig up that awesome gravy. We also go the crab meat glass noodle which is also very good. They do not skimp the crab and it is nice and sweet. Overall a great place to eat and have a nice cocktail.

The coconut crab curry and the sweet tamarind calamari are just haves. The vibe simultaneously gave me the feel of being back in Thailand and being in a trendy Instagram hotspot (which I'm sure it is). The bartender Rubin was also super funny and took great care of us while my date and I waited for a table. This place is a "no pad Thai" zone and it's better for it. I definitely recommend!

Drinks here are great!
Food mmm.. well at ever thai restaurant i come to in the city i always ask for it thai style extra spicy. And it was accomplished. The taste is good, service amazing, and ambiance great! The chicken wings is a must, the currys, and the whole fish MMMMM.... delicious!

Is good for happy hour. Oysters were $1 each, sauce was good and all but some of the oysters are very small and flat. Soup was alright. Wouldn't recommend the steam fish. Not much taste compare to the rest of the stuffs. Wings were good and flavorful. Spicy mango cocktail was good but not the butterfly effect. It was kinda pricey. I would recommend just coming here for beers $5 each, some oysters and wings.

{Overall: 4.5; Food: 5} Atmosphere: 4.5; Service: 4

This is my favorite Thai restaurant in NYC right now. The food is AMAZING, the vibe is cute and laid back, and the service is good. I haven't had a thing that I didn't like. Having tried most of the menu at this point, here are my favorites: 

- Tiger Prawn Karee (my fav dish): It's the sauce that's just incredible. Something you end up wanting to put over all the food.

- Coconut crab curry: Watch out for the spice. Also it's mostly curry with small pieces of crab.

- Steamed fish with Thai herbs: The flavor profile here is so vibrant with a fresh, sour pop in every bite.

*Great bonus for a person with a peanut allergy: only one of the dishes uses peanuts.*

If you are thinking of dining here get a Rez now!! My favorite Thai place in the states. Warning you need to be a fan of seafood and can handle some spice to enjoy! I shared the tasting menu for two and left so uncomfortable but still wanted more. The oysters were topped with a fish spicy lime sauce that I wish I could just pour over a bowl of rice or dip something in! Everything was amazing. The corn salad was light and refreshing. The crab curry cannot be missed and the crispy fish! Go hungry! I want this meal again. The wings were crispy and not greasy and the clams were so fresh served in a spicy black bean sauce. 

I cannot wait to go back here! Be sure to try multiple dishes.

I went here with a friend for dinner on a Friday night. It was crowded but they were able to seat us with not a very long wait. I am vegetarian so going to a thai seafood place was a little tricky but I got the vegan green curry and it was so good. It wasn't bland at all. The waiter mentioned that it would be spicy but I thought it was the perfect level of spice and flavor. The portion was a little big, probably because they recommend sharing the entrees, but I took home the leftovers and ate them the next day and it still tasted great. Definitely recommend going here, especially if you're already in SoHo/near Broadway shopping.

Gonna star by just saying WOW! The food here is soooo goood! They have a few reservations available but for the most part it is walk in only. During lunch you'll definitely have little to no wait, but dinner is always crowded with good reasons!

Some of my favorite dishes here were the pork cheeks, cilantro fish dish, and the crab noodles!

This place is usually super busy and it is very hard to get reservations the day of which is why I recommend you reserve a few weeks to a month in advance. You have to put a credit card on file to book so be aware of that.

We ordered the pork cheeks, khua kling, oysters, coconut crab curry, tiger prawn karee and the fried fish.

The oysters were surprisingly very good for $1 each. They give you fries shallots and a hot sauce to put on the oysters which added a nice crunch and heat to it.

I liked the pork cheeks as well. Not too salty and was surprisingly not too tough.

The coconut crab curry was my favorite dish. The crab was soft and broke apart easily and the curry was creamy, savory, and delicious. 

The tiger prawn karee was good but it was just 3 pieces so I don't think it was worth it for around $30.

I wasn't a fan of the fried fish. All the sauce was on the bottom of the plate and wasn't anything special. At the end of the day it was just a regular piece of fried fish.

The khua kling was just okay as well. It was basically dry rub spicy beef.

Overall this place is good but I like uncle boons better.

Amazing Thai food. We arrived around 12:30 on a Sunday afternoon, and were able to sit at the bar right away. There's a coat/ bag check, which is great. We ordered the happy hour $1 oysters- not my favorite, but the toppings were fun and different.

The crab curry is a MUST! Would not recommend if you don't like spicy food, but for me, it was the perfect amount of spice! So so delicious. We also had Thai iced tea and limeade, both of which were fresh and tasty. 

Try this place for sure, make a reservation if you want to sit at a table!
Amazing food! We liked the grilled pork cheek and the crab aob woonsen In particular! Great place fto celebrate a special occasion

Was looking for something new to try for a Valentine's day celebration.  Saw a video on News12 and decided to give it a try.

Place:
Place has beautiful vibrant colors.  A nice bar and a view into the kitchen.  Beautiful plants everywhere.  One thing is that all the tables are close together.  We were first seated at a small table but after ordering the prefix for 3, they moved us to a bigger table.  We definitely needed the room for all that yummy food.

Service:
Staff is friendly and attentive.  Just great service especially on a busy Valentine's day.

Food:
Pomelo salad
A fresh grapefuit salad.  Some what of a palette cleanser to prep you for  this great meal.  Nice sauce and flavor.

Zabb wings
Dusted fried chicken wings.  At first glance, they looked very plain.  After eating them, it was one of my favorite dishes 

Grilled pork cheeks
A huge star from today's entree.  I could eat a few orders of this.  Juicy tender pork yumminess!

Coconut crab curry
One out of the three curries I received today.  Some nice heat and lemongrass.  A beautiful orange color to match.  This was my most anticipated dish after watching the special on News12.

Fried fish with garden herb Salad
Wow!  This is alone is enough to make you come back.  The fried crispy skin, the fresh greens with mango, chili, and sauce is really special.  Just a must try!  I go to City Island for fish and nothing can match this.

Prawn lon
My least favorite of the curries.  Coconut, prawns, and some jalapenos or chilis.  It was just a tad to sweet for my palette.

Manilla calms with sweet basil
This was my sleeper of the night.  Calms were cooked well but that sauce goes great with the side order of rice.  Definitely a re order item.

Drinks:
Spicy Mango - a spicy mango tequilla.  Double yum!
I don't like sweet drinks and this definitely hit the spot.  Some sweetness but with heat!

Cheeky green - a Thai mojito with Tito's.  Some herbal greens.

Overall a great experience.  This place is literally a party in your mouth with all the great and unique flavor combinations.  While it can be busy or tight, this place delivers great quality dishes.  I plan to go back to try other items on the menu.  You know they hit the mark when you leave with a smile and hours later you still think about those dishes!  Great find and great delivery of original Thai Cuisine by the owner!  Thanks for making my wife's first Thai Experience great!

Wow, so my friend invited me here. She used to work here a while back. The place was very nice and the service was excellent.

We ordered the Steamed Fish with Thai Herbs, Manila Clams with Sweet Basil and Sauteed Cabbage.

Sauteed Cabbage was very flavorful. I was a little surprised how much I enjoyed it. Actually, reminded me of when I was growing up. The Manila clams was excellent. I really enjoyed the sauce/broth it was in. The Steamed Fish was so flavorful. The fish was cooked perfectly and OMG that sauce was excellent.

We were treated to a few extra items.... Coconut Crab Curry was excellent. The heat on it was just right, not over powering. Grilled Pork Cheeks and the sauce was yummy. Shrimp Sao with pineapples was very well balanced. I enjoyed the balance of heat and sweetness.

I normally do not throw out 5 stars. Everything I ate here I would eat again. There was so much food we couldn't finish everything. I did just want to pack up some of the sauces and use them at home. The balance in the food was great. This is a place where you can taste the love in the food. Thank You Fish Cheeks' staff =)

This place is my absolute favorite spot in the city. The bartender Lauren is the best, as are the happy hour specials from 5-7. 

I love the crab curry and the short rib masaman. The side of cabbage is outstaaaanding. So ridiculously good. 

Can't recommend this place enough!

Best date night spot! This place is consistently delicious, spicy, and different. This isn't your ordinary pad Thai- Thai food place. They have a range of unique dishes and I suppose the name hints at this but their fish dishes are phenomenal. Also their $1 oysters are great but kind of dangerous because I feel like I could easily eat 50. 

Try their whole fish dishes. Seriously just the best. In terms of ambiance, it's definitely a bit loud but I like it. It's nice soft lighting and if you're there on a date, you don't have to scream to hear each other. It's fun & romantic all at once.
The crab curry is so flavorful!! We came back again to have it. I love the food here. One of the best curry spot in nyc.
Got food poisoning from the fried fish or oysters, will not be coming here again.  Place is pretty jam packed and seats are uncomfortable.

Came for restaurant week and most of the food was delicious.  The drinks were meh.  The "something different" really is.  And not in a great way.  The service was rough.  Other tables that came in after us were served well before us.  Our bill came out wrong ... twice.  First mistake was by almost 100 bucks.  Please check your bill before handing over the credit card.

Came here for lunch during restaurant week - made reservations through Resy. Definitely recommend reserving even on the weekdays because there was a wait when we came in on a Thursday around 1pm.

We started with the oysters, it was happy hour so they were only $1 and comes with green sauce and fried onions- delicious! The green sauce has a kick to it but added a nice flavor to the oysters.

For appetizers, we got the Zabb wings and Somtum corn salad- both were good and a little spicy. They were very generous with the corn salad portion size. The wings are dry rubbed but still tasted flavorful.

We got the Green Curry and Crab Aob Woosen for our entree. The green curry was delicious and comes with a side of rice. The glass noodles weren't bad but I preferred the curry over them. 

The only dessert they had was coconut ice cream so I decided not to get it. 

Overall a great experience and I can't wait to go back for happy hour (daily between noon to 3:45pm and then 5pm to 7pm) - $10 cocktails, which are usually $15, $1 oysters and $8 wine.

Instagram- HungrySimran

Make sure to make reservations. I walked in without  reservations on a Wednesday @545pm and got lucky to have gotten a table. However, THE BEST THAI FOOD IN NEW YORK CITY. I am Thai so I am speaking FACTS! Got the branzino, pomelo salad (soooo good) and pakboong!!!!! Branzino is spicy but it was the PERFEECTT type of spicyyyy. My favorite Thai spot in all of New York.

We went here for restaurant week to find that they don't do Sundays - even though the restaurant week website says they do. This was obviously disappointing and not what we expected.

We were especially excited to try out this spot, as we've heard great things from many people and the internet raves about this restaurant. Full disclosure: we were not impressed. Don't get us wrong, the food was filling and delicious, but it wasn't anything out of this world and definitely not worth the price. I could go to any other thai restaurant and get similar quality food.

We ordered the Coconut Crab Curry, Manila Clams with Sweet Basil, and Zabb Wings. The Wings were an interesting mix of sweet and sour, they were dry rub but had lime over them. The Crab Curry and Clams were both well made, just nothing to scream about. We also ordered two drinks, that were quite strong - so be prepared when ordering alcohol.

The one saving grace, we will say, is the service here was great. Our waiter was very attentive and answered any questions we had. My original drink was also not to my liking, and he very quickly replaced it with something else. We felt welcomed and taken care of, which was great.

Overall, definitely a nice spot to visit if you want to check it out and have some money to spend. If you're looking to be blown away by the food, however, I'd spend your money somewhere else.

Was as good as a year ago! Food was delicious! Especially steam fish with herbs! Shoutout to our server Cory, cheerful, friendly who gave impeccable service to our group of six even when the restaurant was fully packed! Great job Cory!!!

As a Thai person, I have a very high expectation when it comes to Thai food. I have been here a few times and tried about half of their menu and they are very solid.
Despite their "ok" appetizers, their main dishes are amazing.
Wings could use more spices and the pork was ok good.
I like smaller oysters, but their happy hour oysters are super xxxs tiny. But they are delicious and the sauces go very well with the oysters. 
The crab curry is probably one of the best curry I have had. So creamy, spicy and well balanced!
The whole fish and tiger prawns are amazing.
The service is great and the food is well priced for this area.
It's a bit hard to get a reservation but best to come in right when they open at noon so you can order happy hour items.

Must try: everything but some standouts were the chicken wings and the fried fish. 

seriously delicious and cute trendy place

Has a great happy hour! And really good deals on tasting menus. This is a perfect place for a small grouo or date

First and foremost the food at this place was amazing!!! Everything was prepared fresh,  hot and the seasonings were spot on! 

Everyone who knows me knows that I'm not the biggest fan of thai food so it wouldn't be a choice of mine to go if it was my choice.  

My friend saw this place on IG and suggested we go. I agreed because I owed her birthday dinner and I saw a few things on the menu that looked tasty.

They start you off with some shrimp crisps (don't know the name). And the still water is gross! We ordered the Zabb Wings and they were crisp, spicy and flavorful with a hint of lime juice squeezed on them that gave them an extra pop! We also got crab fried rice,  and Shrimp Karee. The crab fried rice was really good,  it had lots of crab throughout and was very fresh tasting. It was served with 2 sauces on the side. One was some type of cilantro based sauce which was really delicious and spicy.   The other was a more thinner sauce that was very sour and pungent,  I didn't care for that one. The shrimp Karee are head on Prawns (with shells) in a curry sauce that had just the right amount of curry flavor without being overpowering.  The waitress suggested we order some jasmine rice to go with it but we thought since we had the crab rice we didn't need it.  We wound up having to flag her down to order the rice to soak up all the rich curry sauce.  We each got two drinks. I got the spicy mango and my friend got the Butterfly Effect. The mango drink was really tasty with a perfect amount of spice but it had way too much ice in it.  My friend said her drink was strong, but in my opinion it was way too small.  The drinks were $10 for happy hour. They also serve oysters for happy hour for $1 each,  my friend ordered 2 just to try them.  She said they were good. 

My reasons for less stars despite the great food was the service! It takes more than just having great food for an establishment to earn 4-5 stars. I will explain now.  We got there about 5 minutes before they opened the door and a few people were waiting. When it was finally our turn to get to the hostess she asked us how she can help. She's asked if we had a reservation after scrolling through her list on the iPad and asking me several times how to spell my name she couldn't find it. I showed her the text I received. Finally another woman comes over and says something to her in another language and then they seat us at a tiny table by the door. It was cold and we asked if we could move over and she said no because those tables were reserved.  We were sitting and it was really cold so we called her over asking if we could please move. She said she'd check but then never got back to us. The waiter came and we told him we wanted to move,  then another man came over asking what was wrong and we told him we were cold and wanted to move. He said he'd speak to the hostess. She's came over after a few minutes and told us the only other table they had was by the kitchen (there were clearly other 2 people tables we were one of the first 2 there) we agreed to take the table because it was just too cold by the door.  That's the first strike against them.  The second thing was the fact that we waited a really long time to flag down the waitress to ask for the jasmine rice and we also had to then flag her down to order another drink.  Strike 2. The 3rd strike was when we got the bill the waitress said whenever you're ready no rush.  She came back a few minutes later asking if we were all set.  We were talking and hadn't even looked at the bill so we said oh no sorry but then I proceeded to get my card to pay (also there's a sign on their door that says credit cards only) so I put the card in slot & right away someone else came and grabbed it. I left a 20 % tip because service wasn't good enough for more than that.  But here's where the 3rd strike really comes into play.  We're sitting there talking,  catching up on things and the hostess comes over to us and says "I know you're enjoying yourselves but we need the table for our next reservation" I was dumbfounded I couldn't believe they were kicking us out. We got up, got our coats from the coat check and were putting them on over by the front and sure enough that table they had us sitting at first was empty. As expected! Nobody wants to sit by the door with all that traffic and the cold chill coming in every time the door was opened. 

So yes, the food was good and I was satisfied but NO I will not go back due to how we were treated upon arrival and upon leaving.  They don't know if we were going to talk some more and wind up ordering more drinks. They stereotyped us and I didn't like it!

Taking advantage of Restaurant Week and being able to try different items on the menu was a great first time experience!  The food is amazing and the portion was perfect for lunch.  Mid-day happy hour is also a plus to know for future lunch appointments.  It's a cozy spot so you are quite close to the next table.  But looking to exploring more of their menu on the next visit.

Restaurant did not honor restaurant week deal on Sunday, when it clearly lists it on the website for both brunch and dinner. The food was good, but I just felt like it's not fair for people who were looking forward to the restaurant week deal, only to show up and find out the restaurant will not honor it. 

I ordered the crab curry, pork cheeks, and crab fried rice. The curry was very creamy and had a lot of crab meat.

Went here on a Sunday for restaurant week (which is what is listed everywhere) but they only do weekday lunches and dinners. We weren't the first ones to show up there for a restaurant week lunch so I'm a little disappointed that they haven't tried correcting this issue. 

The food, however, was far from disappointing. Loved the food! Best Thai food I've had in a while. We got the coconut crab curry, the tiger prawn karee, and the Po Tak. The po tak is similar to a tom yum soup - very tasty and a little spicy. The other two dishes were also very good.

Went here last night for restaurant week and enjoyed the meal. I ordered the coconut crab curry which had great flavor and was quite good. Warning though, it's pretty spicy! Service was good and the restaurant itself was bustling. Tables are really close together so don't go here if you aren't willing to get cozy. This is a good spot if you are into Thai food but are looking for something that's one level up in fanciness and price.

Given that I was born and raised in Thailand, this place pretty much tastes like home. Obviously, the price reflects its location but this is one of the best Thai food you can get in Manhattan (I like it wayyy more than Uncle Boons), without venturing out to Queens...Thai Town in LA...or Thailand. 

Fish Cheeks really lived up to its name - the "best" part of the fish. I like that they focus on seafood and serve items that are not typical of Thai places in the US. Many dishes are traditional southern Thai food - like the Khua Kling and Coconut Crab Curry...mixed with some other northeastern Thai dishes. 

My favorites at the moment include the grilled pork cheeks (literally one of the best things I have ever eaten in NY) and pomelo salad (so refreshing with bits of dry-aged fried fish). But there are many items I have yet to try on the menu!

Definitely go with another person or even better, a group if you can. These types of meals are meant to be shared. They don't really offer one-person dishes like pad thai/pad see ew.

Can't wait to be back!

Food was good, service was nice, but slow. Definitely more of a $$$ restaurant. Portion sizes are small, especially since you're getting seafood. Got 3 entrees between 2 people and left hungry and broke.

Cute spot. Cute color schemes for the interior. Cute name. Aww. 

Let's get straight to the point!

Ordered the Coconut Crab Curry. Crowd favorite. Makes sense because it was fantastic. The coconut cream gives the curry a silky, velvety texture that goes super well with the rice it comes with and of course, the abundant crab meat in the curry. They do not skimp on that, thankfully. 

Their Crab Aob Woonsen is surprisingly modest in terms of its portions. I feel like they should have also added a bit more sauce in it. The glass noodles could definitely have used some extra flavors. The crab meat was good, but not as good as the ones sitting in the Coconut Curry. The pork belly slices are also a little.. stale in both flavor and appearance. I definitely recommend the Coconut Crab Curry over the Woonsen. 

Standard Thai Iced Tea. I like mine a bit more on the bitter side, but I'm not going to complain about something sweet. Their homemade coconut ice cream with jackfruit and whatever else was also pretty good. Definitely need to share it with though, it's kinda hefty. 

I had a Spicy Mango cocktail for their happy hour price of $10. It's good. Not too strong, not too weak. Right down the middle. Nothing like needing to use the bathroom the rest of the day after starting with a drink.

Gotta love a place with happy hour on the weekends!! We went for lunch happy hour and I have to say the coktsil for $10 is the right pricee (normal price $15) 

The thai old fashioned and the spicy mango were pur favorites (we also tried butterfly effect - very sweet, and the something cheeks which had nice thai bass flavor but was pretty boring would be better with a different spirit than vodka) 


The happy hour ohsters were $1 and they were amazing because they came  out super fast (we werevstarving) and they had a crispy shallot garnish that was awesome as well as a green "seafood" sauce that was very flavorful. I dont often eat oysters w crispy garnishes so that was fun. 

We ordered the coconut crab curry, the fried fish, and the Grilled Pork Cheeks. The fried fish is one of thee best dishes I've had in a long time!! I was so impressed by the cook on it, it was fried super crispy but the inside was perfectly done nice and flaky and steamy. The ggarnish has some tthai bird chilis and they are HOT, after my first bite I made sure I had no more than one chili per bite to try to control the spice level. The curry is also very good and quite spicy, tho more of a slow burn that the chilis with the fish. It was a bit hard to eat, I wish thety served it with bowls instead of plates. You get GIANT chunks of crab, probably some off the biggest I've seen at a restaurant and they are tender and sweet in the spicy curry. Pork cheeks were cooked well and the sauce is tasty but nothing super special there. 

The coco nut ice cream for dessert is a hige two scoop portion which is  perfect to cool you down after those chilis. A great serving size for $9

I would come back for sure and get the fried fish and try some other dishes!!

Fish Cheeks impressed and impressed quickly. From the moment we stepped in, we were wowed by the interior design: hanging plants, weaves-basket lamps, blue fish-scaled tiles at the open bar, seafood-themed choking hazard poster - it was clear that each element was thought out with cohesion in mind.

We were quickly seated at the bar for lunch since it was a full house. Service was a bit slow since they were so busy but our interactions with waiters were generally friendly and pleasant.

Everything was absolutely delicious. We opted for a light lunch - a dozen oysters (HIGHLY RECOMMEND their $1 oyster happy hour daily from 12-3:30/5-7) and the crab curry with two jasmine rices to share. The nam jim seafood sauce and fried shallots made for a delectable and addicting pairing for the oysters: crunchy, zesty, spicy and tangy - we went through the dozen in less than 10 minutes. The crab curry was also superb - the crab meat was tender and the coconut curry itself had an incredible richness thanks to the crab. It was delicious when paired with the warm, fragrant jasmine rice. Granted it was a bit spicier than we expected, but nothing we couldn't handle.

All in all, a fantastic choice for delicious Thai food in a beautiful space. Worth traveling for and worth the wait.

Fish Cheeks 
Keep in mind this restaurant closes mid day and reopens for dinner. We almost made plans for 4pm and luckily we checked the hours before scheduling our date. I would also recommend reservations. The restaurant is a decent size but fills up quickly, not to mention "do you have a reservation?" is the first question asked by the host. 
The ambience is very welcoming, there's a happy hour with "decent prices" considering the location. 10.00 cocktails (I guess.... I would like 6.00 cocktails but I don't own the place lol!) The food was brought out fairly quickly. Complimentary chips and chili is served while you wait.
